item.title: Cheap surgery overseas may come with devastating complications, doctors warn
item.summary: Over three million people travel for cosmetic surgery yearly, but doctors warn the budget-friendly prices often come with extreme risks and complications.

item.title: White House meets AI firm Anthropic amid political tensions, Pentagon dispute
item.summary: Trump administration reconsiders Anthropic ban as CEO meets White House officials to discuss Mythos Preview, a powerful new AI cybersecurity model.

item.title: 1 million bees swarm highway after crash shuts down interstate ramp for hours
item.summary: A truck carrying 1 million bees crashed on Interstate 40 in Knoxville, Tennessee, closing part of the highway as beekeepers scrambled to contain them.

item.title: Ex-USWNT star Megan Rapinoe and WNBA great Sue Bird announce shocking split after 10 years
item.summary: WNBA legend Sue Bird and soccer star Megan Rapinoe announced they have split after 10 years, sharing the news in a joint statement on Friday.

item.title: Video shows teen snatched at bus stop – but victim slips SOS at gas station to escape repeat offender suspect
item.summary: A 16-year-old Michigan student was allegedly abducted at gunpoint while waiting for her school bus by a man charged as a three-time habitual offender.

item.title: Utah leaders launch probe into Supreme Court justice over alleged relationship with redistricting lawyer
item.summary: Utah officials ordered a probe into Supreme Court Justice Diana Hagen over alleged ties to an attorney involved in a key redistricting case ruling.

item.title: Wisconsin sheriff explains why he's suing for $1M after woman allegedly faked ICE detention at a hotel
item.summary: A Wisconsin sheriff sues a woman and a local politician over what he calls an "outlandish" lie about being illegally detained in the county jail.

item.title: Texas AG sues Houston mayor and city council over new sanctuary city ordinance limiting ICE cooperation
item.summary: Texas AG Ken Paxton sued Houston's mayor and city council over a sanctuary ordinance that ended a police policy requiring officers to wait for ICE agents.

item.title: America 250 events taking place this summer called 'once-in-a-lifetime' travel opportunities
item.summary: The U.S. is marking its 250th birthday with carefully planned nationwide events, including tall ship tours, a state fair in D.C., Mount Rushmore fireworks and IndyCar races.
